english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the body left after a person or animal dies.

exampleSentences.english: The police found the remains at the scene.
exampleSentences.traditional: 警方喺現場發現咗一具屍體。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ging2 fong1 hai2 jin6 coeng4 faat3 jin6 zo2 jat1 geoi6 si1 tai2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a dead human body.

exampleSentences.english: The police found a corpse in the back alley.
exampleSentences.traditional: 警方喺後巷發現一具屍體。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ging2 fong1 hai2 hau6 hong2 faat3 jin6 jat1 geoi6 si1 tai2

english.note: Use this specifically when body means a dead person or animal.

exampleSentences.english: The police found a body at the scene.
exampleSentences.traditional: 警方喺現場發現一具屍體。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ging2 fong1 hai2 jin6 coeng4 faat3 jin6 jat1 geoi6 si1 tai2
